transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

My regular doctor sent me. Everyone's making a big fuss because... well, because my weight dropped. I don't really see the issue, to be honest. Being this light just helps me keep up with the work at the shop. I don't get slowed down. But... they insisted I come here.
Have you noticed any other changes in your health recently, like fatigue, increased thirst, or frequent urination?
No. I haven't really noticed anything like that. Just... working like usual.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or any gastrointestinal issues like nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea?
No. My appetite is fine. And my stomach... it's fine too. I don't have any of those things.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy lately?
No... not really. I just... I go to the shop, I do my work. I'm fine.
Have you been eating more than usual or feeling like you can't control how much you eat?
No. I don't have that problem. I... I definitely don't eat more than usual. I'm always in control of it.
Have you noticed yourself drinking more water than usual or feeling unusually thirsty lately?
No... I don't think so. I just drink a normal amount, I guess. I haven't been unusually thirsty or anything like that.
Have you noticed any days where you just don't feel like doing anything, or where things feel like more of a chore than usual?
No... not really. I just... I get up and go to work. It's fine.
Have you noticed any unintentional weight loss recently, even though your appetite has stayed the same or increased?
No... not unintentional, no. I haven't lost weight by accident. And my appetite hasn't gone up, either.
Have you noticed any days where you feel like you can't enjoy anything, even things that usually make you happy?
No... not really. I just do what I need to do every day. I haven't noticed feeling like that.
Have you been doing anything special to keep your weight down, like exercising a lot, using laxatives, or making yourself vomit?
No... I don't do any of that. I don't take pills or... throw up. I just go to work.
Have you felt like things you used to enjoy don't bring you any happiness anymore?
I think you just asked me something like that. No... I haven't. I just do my work and go home. Things are fine.
Have you noticed that you don’t feel much pleasure or happiness, even when something good happens?
You're... you're asking me the exact same thing again. No. If something good happens, I'm fine. I just... I don't know what else to tell you.
Outside of work, have you noticed that you don’t feel much pleasure or happiness doing things you used to enjoy?
I don't... I really don't understand why you keep asking me this. My answer hasn't changed. No. I'm fine.
Have you been through any stressful life events, emotional difficulties, or major changes recently that might be affecting your weight or overall health?
No. Not really. Everything is... exactly the same as it usually is. I just go to work and do my job. Nothing has changed.
Do you find that you no longer take pleasure in activities you used to enjoy, outside of your work at the shop?
I... I don't know how many different ways I can say this. No. I still like the same things I always have. Please stop asking me that.
Have you experienced any days where you didn't feel like eating at all, even when you knew you should?

I don't... I mean, I eat what I need to. On days I'm in the workshop, I usually just have tea. Maybe a few... careful bites of something. Stopping for a real meal just... it feels unnecessary. It throws off the control I've got over the day, so I just... keep working. That's all.
Even though you say your appetite is fine, do you ever find yourself not wanting to eat, even when you know you should?
I... I thought I just answered that. I eat what I need. It's not about not wanting to, I just... I don't need a lot. That's it.
